trap.label: opinião e contraste
trap.wrong: In my opinion, in one hand schools are good, in the other hand costs.
trap.right: In my opinion, on the one hand schools are good; on the other hand, they cost money.
trap.why: Em português “por um lado… por outro” é traduzido literalmente como in one hand. Em inglês é on the one hand… on the other hand.

mcq.q: ___ the one hand, it is cheap.
___ the other hand, it is slow.

fix.wrong: In one hand, it is cheap.
fix.right: On the one hand, it is cheap.

fix.wrong: On my opinion, it is good.
fix.right: In my opinion, it is good.

fix.wrong: If schools will offer classes, students win.
fix.right: If schools offer classes, students will win.

rewrite.prompt: Complete: “___ the one hand it is cheap.”
Reescreva: “Eu acho que é bom.” com opinion
rewrite.answer: In my opinion, it is good.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “If schools will offer classes, students win.”
rewrite.answer: If schools offer classes, students will win.
